HISTORICAL_REPLAY: historical decision_at is replayed using only feature/market information available by that historical decision time
prediction computation may occur later, but evaluation plan must be registered before evaluation_started_at_utc and before final holdout unblinding
prediction_generated_at must be >= evaluation_started_at_utc and is recorded as replay-computation time
PROSPECTIVE: feature snapshot and market quote must be available by decision_at

forbidden: iid bootstrap as only uncertainty method
historical replay presented as prospective evidence
preregistration_rules: plan registration binds exact plan SHA256
HISTORICAL_REPLAY plan need not predate historical event decisions; it must predate evaluation/holdout unblinding
PROSPECTIVE plan must predate first decision_at
thresholds and bootstrap configuration are read only from registered plan
final holdout is last chronological block and may not intersect tuning_record_ids
purpose: Offline fail-closed real OOS/baseline/calibration evidence generation after admitted PIT+identity+rights data evidence.
required_controls: upstream C03/C04/H04 evidence admitted=true and exact file hash bound
sport+competition+market scope equal upstream evidence and preregistered plan
final chronological holdout untouched by tuning
paired moving-block bootstrap CI95 lower bounds > 0
calibration ECE and maximum calibration gap within preregistered limits
segment stability and fold stability above preregistered fractions
multiclass 1X2 evaluated as multiclass, never flattened to silent binary score

result_semantics.FAIL_CLOSED: at least one required control failed
result_semantics.PASS: real evidence satisfies the preregistered OOS gate; this does not itself authorize model promotion, wagering, CONTROLLED_LIVE, or production
